design_philosophy: Functional authority. No decorative gradients. Information is king. Use sharp 1px borders, rigid grids, and high-contrast typography to create a precise, commanding logistics environment.

scale.label: text-[10px] md:text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-neutral-400

layout_and_spacing.general: Bento-style grids with sharp 1px borders, zero border-radius (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`), generous padding `p-6` to `p-12` inside major sections.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 border-r border-neutral-200 bg-[#FAFAFA] flex flex-col pt-8 pb-6 px-4 z-40
layout_and_spacing.hero_section: py-24 px-8 md:px-16 border-b border-neutral-200 relative bg-[#FAFAFA] overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center
layout_and_spacing.hero_pattern: Implement a technical background: a 40px SVG grid pattern using a very faint stroke (e.g., `stroke-neutral-200`) to evoke coordinate tracking.
layout_and_spacing.shipment_list_section: px-8 md:px-16 py-12 bg-white flex flex-col gap-6

hero_search.wrapper: max-w-4xl w-full mx-auto flex flex-col gap-8 relative z-10 bg-white p-8 md:p-12 border border-neutral-200 shadow-xl shadow-neutral-950/5
hero_search.input_group: flex items-center gap-4 border-b-2 border-neutral-950 pb-4 transition-all focus-within:border-blue-600
hero_search.input: text-3xl md:text-5xl font-mono tracking-tighter w-full bg-transparent focus:outline-none placeholder:text-neutral-300 uppercase
hero_search.button: bg-neutral-950 text-white px-8 md:px-12 py-4 text-lg font-medium hover:bg-neutral-800 transition-colors shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2

multimodal_timeline.wrapper: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center w-full mt-12 overflow-x-auto pb-4
multimodal_timeline.node: flex flex-col gap-3 min-w-[160px] shrink-0 relative flex-1 group
multimodal_timeline.node_icon_box: w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center border border-neutral-200 bg-white transition-colors z-10
multimodal_timeline.connector: absolute top-6 left-12 w-[calc(100%-3rem)] h-px bg-neutral-200
multimodal_timeline.connector_active: absolute top-6 left-12 w-[calc(100%-3rem)] h-px bg-neutral-950

shipment_list.wrapper: w-full grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6
shipment_list.card: border border-neutral-200 bg-white p-6 hover:border-neutral-400 transition-colors flex flex-col gap-4 cursor-pointer

badges.style: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-widest uppercase border border-neutral-200 gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive cards and buttons should have a rigid translation `hover:-translate-y-[2px]` and intense shadow `hover:shadow-lg`.
motion_and_interactions.timeline_reveal: Use stagger animations for the multimodal timeline nodes. The active/current leg should pulse subtly.

icons_and_assets.instructions: Use lucide-react (default). Essential icons: Plane, Ship, Truck, PackageCheck, MapPin, Search, ArrowRight, Activity, Globe.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind classes for layout, relying on bento-grid concepts rather than generic cards.
The Hero section MUST contain a massive input field for the 'Tracking ID'. Below it, if a shipment is tracked, reveal the 'Multimodal Timeline'.

Create realistic mock data for 3-4 shipments. Example journey: Shenzhen (Origin/Factory) -> Road (Truck) -> Yantian Port -> Ocean (Vessel: Evergreen) -> Long Beach Port -> Road (Truck) -> Los Angeles (Destination).
Render the multimodal timeline nodes with exact functional colors and icons based on mode (sky blue for Air, deep blue for Ocean, emerald for Road).

Make sure the typography scale is rigidly applied: massive headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk', technical details in 'JetBrains Mono', and clean body in 'IBM Plex Sans'. Apply tracking-tight and leading-none to headings.
Use a subtle SVG coordinate grid in the hero background. Pure white/gray background, no gradients.
Ensure the sidebar has distinct navigation items with hover states, avoiding a generic 'hamburger' on desktop.
Implement the 'Shipment List' as a grid of dense bento-cards (not a simple table) to show Origin, Destination, current mode icon, and ETA prominently.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive and data-display components.
